chains.title: Null: no TF-mediated allelic effect at rs11629191
predictions: No allele-specific transcription factor binding at rs11629191 in MCF7 or relevant breast cells.
Any breast cancer association is explained by linkage disequilibrium with a nearby causal variant, not by this variant itself.
falsified_if: Allele-specific binding of a specific TF at rs11629191 is demonstrated, and the variant-containing element shows allele-dependent enhancer activity.
A reporter assay shows that the rs11629191 alleles differentially affect expression in a TF-dependent manner.

chains.title: FOXA1 binds the alt allele more strongly at a distal enhancer regulating PELI2

links.claim: The alt T allele creates or strengthens a FOXA1 binding site, so FOXA1 binds the alt allele more strongly than the ref C allele.
rs11629191 lies in a candidate distal enhancer that is active in MCF7 breast cancer cells.
This enhancer regulates PELI2 expression, with the alt allele increasing PELI2 transcription.
FOXA1 is expressed in MCF7 breast cancer epithelial cells, where the enhancer is active.
Increased FOXA1-dependent PELI2 expression promotes breast cancer risk or progression.

predictions: FOXA1 ChIP-qPCR or EMSA shows stronger binding to the alt T allele than to the ref C allele.
An allele-specific reporter in MCF7 shows higher activity for the alt allele, and FOXA1 knockdown reduces this difference.
PELI2 expression correlates with the alt allele in MCF7 or breast tissue.
falsified_if: FOXA1 binds both alleles equally, or binds the ref C allele more strongly.
The alt allele does not increase reporter activity in MCF7, or the effect is not FOXA1-dependent.

chains.title: TFAP2C binds the alt allele more strongly at an enhancer regulating PELI2

links.claim: The alt T allele creates or strengthens a TFAP2C binding site, so TFAP2C binds the alt allele more strongly than the ref C allele.
rs11629191 lies in a candidate distal enhancer active in MCF7 breast cancer cells.
This enhancer regulates PELI2 expression, with the alt allele increasing PELI2 transcription.
TFAP2C is expressed in MCF7 breast cancer epithelial cells and can act at breast-cancer enhancers.
Increased TFAP2C-dependent PELI2 expression promotes breast cancer risk or progression.

predictions: TFAP2C ChIP-qPCR or EMSA shows stronger binding to the alt T allele than to the ref C allele.
TFAP2C knockdown reduces the alt-allele-specific reporter activity in MCF7.
PELI2 expression is higher with the alt allele in TFAP2C-expressing breast cells.
falsified_if: TFAP2C binds both alleles equally or prefers the ref C allele.
The alt allele effect on reporter activity is unchanged by TFAP2C depletion.

chains.title: GATA3 binds the ref allele more strongly and loss of binding increases risk

links.claim: The ref C allele preserves a GATA3 binding site, so GATA3 binds the ref allele more strongly than the alt T allele.
rs11629191 lies in a candidate distal enhancer active in MCF7 breast cancer cells.
GATA3 binding at this enhancer represses or buffers PELI2 expression, so the alt allele increases PELI2.
GATA3 is expressed in MCF7 breast cancer epithelial cells and contributes to breast epithelial enhancer regulation.
Loss of GATA3-mediated repression and increased PELI2 expression promote breast cancer risk or progression.

predictions: GATA3 ChIP-qPCR or EMSA shows stronger binding to the ref C allele than to the alt T allele.
The alt allele increases reporter activity in MCF7, and GATA3 overexpression reduces this increase.
GATA3 depletion raises PELI2 expression, mimicking the alt allele.
falsified_if: GATA3 binds both alleles equally or prefers the alt T allele.
GATA3 overexpression does not repress the element or does not alter PELI2 expression.

chains.title: ESR1 binds the alt allele more strongly at an enhancer regulating PELI2

links.claim: The alt T allele creates or strengthens an ESR1 binding site, so ESR1 binds the alt allele more strongly than the ref C allele.
rs11629191 lies in a candidate distal enhancer active in MCF7 breast cancer cells.
ESR1 binding at this enhancer increases PELI2 expression.
MCF7 cells express ESR1 and use estrogen-receptor-dependent enhancers.
Increased ESR1-dependent PELI2 expression promotes breast cancer risk or progression.

predictions: ESR1 ChIP-qPCR or EMSA shows stronger binding to the alt T allele than to the ref C allele.
The alt-allele reporter effect in MCF7 is estrogen-dependent and reduced by ESR1 knockdown or antagonist treatment.
PELI2 expression is higher with the alt allele in ESR1-positive breast cells.
falsified_if: ESR1 binds both alleles equally or prefers the ref C allele.
The alt-allele reporter effect is unchanged by ESR1 depletion or estrogen deprivation.

matrix.test: Allele-specific FOXA1 ChIP-qPCR or EMSA at rs11629191 in MCF7 cells

outcomes.outcome: FOXA1 binds the alt T allele more strongly than the ref C allele.
No allele-specific FOXA1 binding is detected at rs11629191.

matrix.test: Allele-specific TFAP2C ChIP-qPCR or EMSA at rs11629191 in MCF7 cells

outcomes.outcome: TFAP2C binds the alt T allele more strongly than the ref C allele.
No allele-specific TFAP2C binding is detected.

matrix.test: Allele-specific luciferase reporter for rs11629191 in MCF7 cells with FOXA1 knockdown

outcomes.outcome: The alt allele increases reporter activity and FOXA1 knockdown reduces the allelic difference.
The two alleles show no reproducible difference in reporter activity.

next_experiment: Run allele-specific FOXA1 ChIP-qPCR or EMSA at rs11629191 in MCF7 cells; this is the cheapest test that directly separates the top non-null FOXA1 chain from the null by asking whether FOXA1 binding is stronger on the alt T allele.
